decisive_items: neoplastic infiltration consisting of small round blue cells
Positive for MyoD1, myogenin, vimentin, and desmin
Papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia, edema of dermal papillae, and neoplastic infiltration consisting of small round blue cells with alternating areas of dense and loose cellularity
response.rationale: R5 is the champion because it has more comprehensive support from the raw text, including histopathology and immunohistochemistry results, which are decisive for the diagnosis of Rhabdomyosarcoma. C1, while similar, lacks the breadth of supporting evidence found in R5.
